decisions.reason: As a modular successor to the already well-liked BASIC 518 with its own market presentation, it extends a proven concept and still has strong option value with little reason to abandon it so soon.
A newly launched multi-model mobile shredder line with its own page fits the firm's core mobile processing business, so management would keep learning from the market rather than exit early.

Although only mentioned on the website and therefore less validated commercially, the mobile high-speed grinder is close to the firm's existing capabilities and worth keeping as an option for another year.

The stationary electric fine shredder appears more niche and less visibly established, but it matches the firm's resource-saving and tougher-processing direction, so it is still worth retaining while uncertainty resolves.

The green-waste mobile grinder targets a recognizable customer segment within the firm's markets, and despite limited evidence so far it is inexpensive strategically to keep open for further market feedback.
A dedicated page and a full line of stationary single-shaft pre-shredders suggest a serious launch in a complementary application area, making near-term withdrawal unlikely.
